_meta.title: Leviticus — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Leviticus (holiness, atonement, love of neighbor, jubilee, God dwelling among his people). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 3 Leviticus); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the substantive chapters; ritual/ceremonial-law chapters largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.plain: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continually; it must never go out.
verses.visual_prompt: a small stone incense altar in a quiet courtyard corner at daybreak in an acacia-wood table beside a bronze basin

verses.text: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.plain: For I am the Lord your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy.
verses.visual_prompt: a quiet stone courtyard archway opening onto the hills in a rough-hewn stone altar clearing beneath Sinai

verses.text: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.
verses.plain: For on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you, so that you will be clean from all your sins before the Lord.
verses.visual_prompt: a rough-hewn limestone bench overlooking a quiet valley in a rough-hewn stone altar clearing beneath Sinai

verses.text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.
verses.plain: Speak to the whole assembly of Israel and say to them: Be holy, because I, the Lord your God, am holy.
verses.visual_prompt: a gnarled fig tree casting open contour lines across rocky ground in an acacia-wood table beside a bronze basin

verses.text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.
verses.plain: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord.
verses.visual_prompt: a rough-hewn limestone bench overlooking a quiet valley in the quiet threshold of the tent of meeting

verses.text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.plain: Set apart the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It will be a jubilee for you; each of you is to return to your family property and your own clan.
verses.visual_prompt: a gnarled fig tree casting open contour lines across rocky ground in the quiet outer courtyard of the wilderness Tabernacle

verses.text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.plain: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.
verses.visual_prompt: a narrow footpath bordered by stacked fieldstones winding into a quiet valley in the quiet outer courtyard of the wilderness Tabernacle
